subject: Altarex: minimal retention evidence and export workflow request
messages:
From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@altarex.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Altarex Security <security@altarex.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Minimal retention evidence and export workflow request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. Our security team needs a concise package showing how Redwood can (a) limit telemetry retention for Altarex tenant data to a minimal window, (b) export a tamper-evident copy of retained logs on request, and (c) produce proof that specific records were deleted following export. This is for an upcoming SOC 2 evidence submission and a CAIQ spot-check.

Requested artifacts (high level):
- Retention matrix (what we keep, category -> TTL) for tenant-scoped telemetry and debug traces
- Export playbook: steps, output format, authentication & signing mechanism
- Proof-of-delete examples (redacted) or manifest format you can provide
- A short note mapping these items to SOC 2/CAIQ control references if possible

Attached is a short summary of our ask. We aim to provide this to our auditor by Feb 24. Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Also please call out any limitations for hosted vs private deployments.

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Head of Security Ops — Altarex Therapeutics
Attachment: Altarex-request-summary.pdf
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@altarex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Minimal retention evidence and export workflow request

Hi Tom —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick summary of what Redwood can provide for Altarex (hosted deployment):

1) Retention matrix (deliverable):
- Tenant telemetry (conversational events, inference traces): configurable TTL, default 30 days; can be reduced to 7 days for experimental carve-outs.
- System debug traces & worker logs: 90-day default; can provide sampled slices for audits.

2) Export/playbook (deliverable):
- We can produce an export bundle (NDJSON) with a signed manifest (SHA256 per file) and a signed metadata file with timestamp and KMS key-id. The playbook documents auth flow, rate limits, and retention state snapshot steps.

3) Proof-of-delete (deliverable):
- Options: (A) signed deletion manifest with KMS-backed signature + object tombstone records; (B) redacted sample records plus hash list. Note that full raw records cannot be returned after deletion — we provide hashes and deletion timestamps as industry-standard proof.

4) Control mapping (deliverable):
- We'll map artifacts to relevant SOC 2 criteria and CAIQ control IDs (e.g., change/retention evidence for logging and access controls). Neha will add the specific control IDs and a brief bridging statement.

Limitations / notes:
- Hosted: export uses a per-tenant ephemeral export URL, valid for 24h, with an audit log entry. For very short TTLs (<7d) we may need to coordinate retention policy rollout timelines to ensure exported slices exist.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): we can provide the same artifacts but collection method differs — will note in the playbook.

ETA: I can share the retention matrix and export playbook draft by EOD Feb 18. Neha: can you confirm evidence artifacts and control mapping? Marissa: please include any customer-facing examples you already have.

Next step: proposed 30-min workshop to walk the playbook and agree redaction scope. Are you available next Wed or Thu?

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_export-playbook_v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Minimal retention evidence and export workflow request

Hi Tom / team —

Adding the security perspective and some concrete artifacts we can include. High level mapping and what we can deliver for hosted Altarex tenant: 

What we can produce now (hosted):
- Retention matrix CSV (fields: data_category, default_ttl, tenant_override_allowed, notes)
- Export bundle: NDJSON + manifest.json (manifest includes file checksums, creation timestamp, and signer: redwood-export@redwood.ai KMS key id xxxxx)
- Deletion evidence: signed deletion-manifest.csv (object id, sha256, deletion_timestamp, deletion_actor) + snapshot of retention policy version (policy_id + timestamp)
- Audit log extract for export and deletion actions (timestamped, truncated)

SOC 2 / CAIQ mapping notes (short):
- Logging & Monitoring: evidence supports SOC 2 CC6 and CAIQ LOG-1/LOG-2 style controls (we will include a concise bridging statement).
- Access & Authentication: export auth uses short-lived tokens and audit hooks (mapped to CAIQ IAM controls).

Limitations / clarifications:
- We cannot provide raw contents of deleted records as proof; instead we provide cryptographic hashes and signed manifests for non-repudiation. That is a common pattern accepted by auditors.
- For very short retention windows (<7 days) customers must confirm a timeline so exports can be scheduled before deletion windows advance.

Attachments included in initial bundle: altarex_evidence_bundle_stub.zip (contains sample manifest, sample deletion-manifest.csv, and a redacted audit log). We'll provide the full deliverables in a zip when you confirm scope.

Proposal: Redacted sample + signed manifests is usually sufficient for CAIQ spot-checks. If your auditor requires full-record replays we can evaluate under a scoped exception but that requires admin review.

Can we book the workshop for Wednesday at 13:00 PT / 16:00 ET? If that works I will invite Sarah (SOC 2 PM) to address mapping questions.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: altarex_evidence_bundle_stub.zip
